notes.raw:
Phase changes: 828 K, α - β transition point of Sr; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.180$ kcal/mol. 1041 K, melting point of Sr; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.960$ kcal/mol. 1654.1 K, boiling point of Sr; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 32.730$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations:
298.15-2000 K: $Cp^0 = 7.759 + 1.562 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.225 \times 10^5 \text{T}^{-2}$
$H^0 - H_{298}^0 = 7.759 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.781 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^2 - 0.225 \times 10^2 \text{T}^{-1} - 2.307$
Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-828 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 11.079 - 1.007 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 1.911 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 30.950 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 11.079 + 1.007 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 1.911 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 15.475 \text{T}^{-1} - 26.380 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
828-1041 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 12.842 - 5.412 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.621 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 56.650 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 12.842 + 5.412 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.621 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 28.325 \text{T}^{-1} - 55.998 \times 10^{43} \text{T}$
1041-1654.1 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 10.257 - 4.813 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.621 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 56.650 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 10.257 + 4.813 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.621 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 28.325 \text{T}^{-1} - 49.346 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1654.1-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -18.620 - 6.686 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 1.596 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 5717.350 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -18.620 + 6.686 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 1.596 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 2858.675 \text{T}^{-1} - 43.122 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Source: Data from Chase (17) who estimated some molecular constants.
